zh-CN.name: 网格布局
zh-CN.description: 用共享列线与间距统一页面结构，窄屏时重新组织列数。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用共享网格列线组织卡片与标题，统一间距；窄屏改为单列，避免横向溢出，保持阅读顺序。
专属演示：真实 CSS 网格按列数和间距重排内容，窄屏保留阅读顺序。 参数：网格列数 {columns}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Grid Layout
en.description: Align elements using shared columns and gaps, and adapt column count on narrow screens.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Organize headings and cards on shared grid lines with consistent gaps. Use one column on narrow screens, avoid horizontal overflow, and preserve reading order.
Dedicated demonstration: A real CSS grid reflows content with column and gap controls, retaining reading order on narrow screens. Parameters: grid columns {columns}; content gap {gap_px}px.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
